description: This file defines data structures and logic related to session data management in an application, including session records, token statistics, session state, and loading mechanisms for session data from a gateway or external source.

classes.name: GatewaySessionDefaultsRecord
classes.description: Stores default session parameters such as model name and context tokens.

classes.name: GatewaySessionEntryRecord
classes.description: Represents individual session entries with various metadata and token counts.

classes.name: GatewaySessionsListResponse
classes.description: Response structure containing a list of session entries and associated metadata.

classes.name: SessionTokenStats
classes.description: Holds input, output, total tokens, and provides formatted summaries and percentage usage.

classes.name: SessionRow
classes.description: Represents a session in a UI-friendly format, including metadata, age, flags, and token stats.

classes.name: SessionKind
classes.description: Enumeration representing the type of session, such as direct, group, global, or unknown.

classes.name: SessionDefaults
classes.description: Default session parameters including model and context tokens.

classes.name: ModelChoice
classes.description: Represents a selectable AI model with associated metadata.

classes.name: SessionLoadError
classes.description: Error types related to loading session data from the gateway.

classes.name: SessionStoreSnapshot
classes.description: Snapshot of session store including path, defaults, and session rows.

methods.name: SessionKind.from
methods.description: Creates a SessionKind based on a session key string.

methods.name: SessionKind.label
methods.description: Provides a human-readable label for the session kind.

methods.name: SessionKind.tint
methods.description: Returns a color associated with the session kind.

methods.name: SessionRow.label
methods.description: Returns display label, prioritizing displayName over key.

methods.name: SessionRow.flagLabels
methods.description: Generates flag labels based on session properties like thinking level, verbose level, systemSent, and aborted state.

methods.name: SessionRow.ageText
methods.description: Calculates the relative age of the session based on last update.
